Directions to the Secretariat

The offices of the GBIF Secretariat are easily accessible by public transport, bike or car. Set your destination as 'Global Biodiversity Information Facility' (55°42'07.9"N 12°33'33.2"E - 55.702200, 12.559210).

Visitors arriving from Copenhagen Airport can simply take the Metro M2 from the airport, change line to Metro M3 (direction via Østerport) at Kongens Nytorv Station and get off at Vibenshus Runddel Station.

The office is no more than five-minutes walk from the metro stop Vibenshus Runddel Station

For public transport from other locations, you can also use the Rejseplanen app or website for directions.
